sections.title: Multiple choice

questions.q: Which ONE of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.qAf: Watter EEN van die volgende is ’n vektorhoeveelheid?

questions.q: A car moves at a constant velocity. Its acceleration is …
questions.qAf: ’n Motor beweeg teen ’n konstante snelheid. Sy versnelling is …

questions.q: The gradient of a velocity–time graph represents the …
questions.qAf: Die gradiënt van ’n snelheid-tyd-grafiek stel die … voor.

questions.q: An object is dropped from rest and falls freely. Its speed after 2 s is …
questions.qAf: ’n Voorwerp word uit rus laat val en val vry. Sy spoed ná 2 s is …

questions.q: At the highest point of its path, a ball thrown vertically upwards has …
questions.qAf: By die hoogste punt van sy baan het ’n bal wat vertikaal opwaarts gegooi is …

questions.q: In a longitudinal wave the particles of the medium vibrate …
questions.qAf: In ’n longitudinale golf vibreer die deeltjies van die medium …
options: perpendicular to the direction of propagation.
parallel to the direction of propagation.

questions.q: Which type of electromagnetic radiation has the highest frequency?
questions.qAf: Watter soort elektromagnetiese straling het die hoogste frekwensie?

questions.q: The pitch of a sound is determined by its …
questions.qAf: Die toonhoogte van ’n klank word bepaal deur sy …

questions.q: A neutral glass rod becomes positively charged when it is rubbed with silk, because it …
questions.qAf: ’n Neutrale glasstaaf word positief gelaai wanneer dit met sy gevryf word, omdat dit …

questions.q: A 6 Ω and a 3 Ω resistor are connected in parallel. Their equivalent resistance is …
questions.qAf: ’n Resistor van 6 Ω en een van 3 Ω word in parallel verbind. Hul ekwivalente weerstand is …

sections.intro: Choose the correct answer. Use g = 9,8 m·s⁻², c = 3 × 10⁸ m·s⁻¹, h = 6,63 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s and e = 1,6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C where needed.
sections.introAf: Kies die korrekte antwoord. Gebruik g = 9,8 m·s⁻², c = 3 × 10⁸ m·s⁻¹, h = 6,63 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s en e = 1,6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C waar nodig.

questions.q: Define a vector quantity.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n vektorhoeveelheid.
points: A physical quantity that has magnitude

questions.scenario: A learner walks 40 m east, then 70 m west and then 10 m east. The whole walk takes 60 s.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Leerder stap 40 m oos, dan 70 m wes en dan 10 m oos. Die hele stap duur 60 s.

questions.q: Calculate the total distance walked.
questions.qAf: Bereken die totale afstand wat gestap is.

questions.q: Determine the resultant displacement of the learner.
questions.qAf: Bepaal die resulterende verplasing van die leerder.

questions.q: Calculate the average speed and the average velocity of the learner.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gemiddelde spoed en die gemiddelde snelheid van die leerder.

questions.q: Explain why the average velocity is smaller than the average speed.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die gemiddelde snelheid kleiner as die gemiddelde spoed is.
points: The learner changed direction, so the displacement is smaller than the distance
pointsAf: Die leerder het van rigting verander, dus is die verplasing kleiner as die afstand

questions.q: Forces of 15 N east, 9 N west and 4 N east act on an object. Determine the resultant force.
questions.qAf: Kragte van 15 N oos, 9 N wes en 4 N oos werk op ’n voorwerp in. Bepaal die resulterende krag.

sections.title: Motion in one dimension: graphs

questions.q: Describe the motion of the cyclist between t = 10 s and t = 25 s.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die beweging van die fietsryer tussen t = 10 s en t = 25 s.

questions.q: Calculate the acceleration of the cyclist during the first 10 s.
questions.qAf: Bereken die versnelling van die fietsryer gedurende die eerste 10 s.

questions.q: Calculate the acceleration of the cyclist between t = 25 s and t = 30 s.
questions.qAf: Bereken die versnelling van die fietsryer tussen t = 25 s en t = 30 s.

questions.q: Calculate the total displacement of the cyclist in the 30 s.
questions.qAf: Bereken die totale verplasing van die fietsryer in die 30 s.
points: Displacement = area under the graph: ½(10)(8) = 40 m
total = 180 m in the direction of motion
pointsAf: Verplasing = oppervlakte onder die grafiek: ½(10)(8) = 40 m

questions.q: Calculate the average velocity of the cyclist for the whole 30 s.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gemiddelde snelheid van die fietsryer vir die hele 30 s.
points: = 6 m·s⁻¹ in the direction of motion

questions.q: Sketch the acceleration–time graph for the motion of the cyclist from t = 0 s to t = 30 s.
questions.qAf: Skets die versnelling-tyd-grafiek vir die beweging van die fietsryer van t = 0 s tot t = 30 s.

questions.q: Describe the shape of the position–time graph for the first 10 s and explain your answer.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die vorm van die posisie-tyd-grafiek vir die eerste 10 s en verduidelik jou antwoord.
points: A curve that gets steeper (increasing gradient)
the gradient of a position–time graph is the velocity
and the velocity increases during the first 10 s
pointsAf: die gradiënt van ’n posisie-tyd-grafiek is die snelheid
en die snelheid neem gedurende die eerste 10 s toe

sections.intro: The velocity–time graph below shows the motion of a cyclist along a straight road.
sections.introAf: Die snelheid-tyd-grafiek hieronder toon die beweging van ’n fietsryer langs ’n reguit pad.

questions.scenario: A car travelling at 25 m·s⁻¹ brakes uniformly and comes to rest in 5 s.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Motor wat teen 25 m·s⁻¹ ry, rem eenvormig en kom in 5 s tot stilstand.

questions.q: Calculate the acceleration of the car.
questions.qAf: Bereken die versnelling van die motor.

questions.q: Calculate the braking distance.
questions.qAf: Bereken die remafstand.

questions.q: The driver’s reaction time is 0,8 s. Calculate the total stopping distance of the car.
questions.qAf: Die bestuurder se reaksietyd is 0,8 s. Bereken die totale stopafstand van die motor.

questions.scenario: A stone is dropped from rest from a bridge and hits the water 2,5 s later. Ignore air resistance.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Klip word uit rus van ’n brug laat val en tref die water 2,5 s later. Ignoreer lugweerstand.

questions.q: Calculate the speed of the stone when it hits the water.
questions.qAf: Bereken die spoed van die klip wanneer dit die water tref.

questions.q: Calculate the height of the bridge above the water.
questions.qAf: Bereken die hoogte van die brug bo die water.

questions.q: Write down the magnitude and direction of the acceleration of a freely falling object.
questions.qAf: Skryf die grootte en rigting van die versnelling van ’n vryvallende voorwerp neer.

questions.q: Define gravitational potential energy.
questions.qAf: Definieer gravitasie-potensiële energie.
points: The energy an object has because of its position
in the gravitational field, relative to a reference point
pointsAf: Die energie wat ’n voorwerp het as gevolg van sy posisie
in die gravitasieveld, relatief tot ’n verwysingspunt

questions.q: State the principle of conservation of mechanical energy.
questions.qAf: Stel die beginsel van behoud van meganiese energie.
points: The total mechanical energy in an isolated system
pointsAf: Die totale meganiese energie in ’n geïsoleerde sisteem

questions.scenario: A 2 kg ball is released from rest at A, 5 m above the ground, and rolls down a frictionless track. B is 1,8 m above the ground and C is on the ground.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Bal van 2 kg word uit rus by A, 5 m bo die grond, losgelaat en rol teen ’n wrywinglose baan af. B is 1,8 m bo die grond en C is op die grond.

questions.q: Calculate the gravitational potential energy of the ball at A.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gravitasie-potensiële energie van die bal by A.

questions.q: Write down the mechanical energy of the ball at A.
questions.qAf: Skryf die meganiese energie van die bal by A neer.
points: 98 J (the kinetic energy at A is zero)
pointsAf: 98 J (die kinetiese energie by A is nul)

questions.q: Calculate the speed of the ball at B.
questions.qAf: Bereken die spoed van die bal by B.

questions.q: Calculate the speed of the ball at C.
questions.qAf: Bereken die spoed van die bal by C.

questions.q: The track is replaced by a rough track of the same shape, and the ball now reaches C at 8 m·s⁻¹. Calculate the mechanical energy converted to other forms of energy.
questions.qAf: Die baan word vervang deur ’n growwe baan met dieselfde vorm, en die bal bereik C nou teen 8 m·s⁻¹. Bereken die meganiese energie wat na ander vorme van energie omgeskakel is.

questions.q: The speed of an object doubles. By what factor does its kinetic energy change? Explain.
questions.qAf: Die spoed van ’n voorwerp verdubbel. Met watter faktor verander sy kinetiese energie? Verduidelik.
points: It becomes four times as large
because E_k = ½mv², so E_k ∝ v²
pointsAf: Dit word vier keer so groot
omdat E_k = ½mv², dus E_k ∝ v²

sections.title: Transverse waves

questions.q: Define a transverse wave.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n transversale golf.
points: A wave in which the particles of the medium vibrate perpendicular
to the direction of propagation of the wave
pointsAf: ’n Golf waarin die deeltjies van die medium loodreg
op die voortplantingsrigting van die golf vibreer

questions.q: Write down the amplitude of the wave.
questions.qAf: Skryf die amplitude van die golf neer.

questions.q: Determine the wavelength of the wave.
questions.qAf: Bepaal die golflengte van die golf.

questions.q: Calculate the period of the wave.
questions.qAf: Bereken die periode van die golf.

questions.q: Calculate the speed of the wave.
questions.qAf: Bereken die spoed van die golf.

questions.q: Name TWO points on the diagram that are in phase.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE punte op die diagram wat in fase is.
points: P and R (or Q and S)
pointsAf: P en R (of Q en S)

questions.q: The frequency is doubled while the wave travels in the same rope. What happens to the wavelength? Explain.
questions.qAf: Die frekwensie word verdubbel terwyl die golf in dieselfde tou beweeg. Wat gebeur met die golflengte? Verduidelik.
points: The speed stays the same in the same medium
v = fλ, so λ is inversely proportional to f
pointsAf: Die spoed bly dieselfde in dieselfde medium
v = fλ, dus is λ omgekeerd eweredig aan f

sections.intro: The diagram shows a transverse wave on a rope. The wave has a frequency of 5 Hz.
sections.introAf: Die diagram toon ’n transversale golf op ’n tou. Die golf het ’n frekwensie van 5 Hz.

questions.q: Explain why sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom klank nie deur ’n vakuum kan beweeg nie.
points: it needs particles of a medium to travel through
pointsAf: dit het deeltjies van ’n medium nodig om deur te beweeg

questions.q: A learner shouts towards a cliff and hears the echo 1,5 s later. The speed of sound in air is 340 m·s⁻¹. Calculate the distance between the learner and the cliff.
questions.qAf: ’n Leerder skree na ’n krans toe en hoor die eggo 1,5 s later. Die spoed van klank in lug is 340 m·s⁻¹. Bereken die afstand tussen die leerder en die krans.
points: the sound travels there and back, so divide by 2
pointsAf: die klank beweeg heen en terug, dus deel deur 2

questions.q: What is ultrasound?
questions.qAf: Wat is ultraklank?
points: Sound with a frequency higher than 20 kHz
above the upper limit of human hearing
pointsAf: Klank met ’n frekwensie hoër as 20 kHz
bo die boonste grens van menslike gehoor

questions.q: Give ONE medical use of ultrasound.
questions.qAf: Gee EEN mediese gebruik van ultraklank.
points: Imaging a foetus or organs in the body (sonar scan)
pointsAf: Beelde van ’n fetus of organe in die liggaam (sonarskandering)

questions.q: Which property of a sound wave determines its loudness?
questions.qAf: Watter eienskap van ’n klankgolf bepaal sy luidheid?

questions.q: Explain why sound travels faster in solids than in gases.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom klank vinniger in vaste stowwe as in gasse beweeg.
points: The particles in a solid are much closer together
so the vibrations are passed on more quickly
pointsAf: Die deeltjies in ’n vaste stof is baie nader aan mekaar
dus word die vibrasies vinniger oorgedra

questions.q: Arrange the following in order of INCREASING wavelength: radio waves, X-rays, visible light, microwaves.
questions.qAf: Rangskik die volgende in volgorde van TOENEMENDE golflengte: radiogolwe, X-strale, sigbare lig, mikrogolwe.

questions.q: Calculate the frequency of green light with a wavelength of 500 nm.
questions.qAf: Bereken die frekwensie van groen lig met ’n golflengte van 500 nm.

questions.q: Calculate the energy of one photon of this light.
questions.qAf: Bereken die energie van een foton van hierdie lig.

questions.q: Ultraviolet radiation is more harmful to the skin than visible light. Explain why.
questions.qAf: Ultravioletstraling is skadeliker vir die vel as sigbare lig. Verduidelik waarom.
points: so each photon carries more energy (E = hf)
pointsAf: dus dra elke foton meer energie (E = hf)

questions.q: State the principle of conservation of charge.
questions.qAf: Stel die beginsel van behoud van lading.
points: The net charge of an isolated system
pointsAf: Die netto lading van ’n geïsoleerde sisteem

questions.scenario: Two identical metal spheres on insulated stands carry charges of +8 nC (sphere A) and −2 nC (sphere B). They are brought into contact and then separated.
questions.scenarioAf: Twee identiese metaalsfere op geïsoleerde staanders dra ladings van +8 nC (sfeer A) en −2 nC (sfeer B). Hulle word in kontak gebring en dan geskei.

questions.q: Calculate the charge on each sphere after they are separated.
questions.qAf: Bereken die lading op elke sfeer nadat hulle geskei is.

questions.q: Calculate the number of electrons transferred, and state the direction in which they moved.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal elektrone wat oorgedra is, en noem die rigting waarin hulle beweeg het.
points: Change in charge of B = 3 − (−2) = 5 nC
pointsAf: Verandering in lading van B = 3 − (−2) = 5 nC

questions.q: A charged rod attracts small pieces of neutral paper. Explain why.
questions.qAf: ’n Gelaaide staaf trek klein stukkies neutrale papier aan. Verduidelik waarom.
points: The rod causes the charges in the paper to separate (polarisation), with opposite charge closest to the rod
the attraction of the nearby opposite charge is stronger than the repulsion of the like charge further away
pointsAf: Die staaf laat die ladings in die papier skei (polarisasie), met teenoorgestelde lading die naaste aan die staaf
die aantrekking van die nabye teenoorgestelde lading is sterker as die afstoting van die gelyke lading verder weg

questions.q: Explain why an object cannot have a charge of 2,4 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n voorwerp nie ’n lading van 2,4 × 10⁻¹⁹ C kan hê nie.
points: charge is quantised: it must be a whole-number multiple of e
pointsAf: lading is gekwantiseer: dit moet ’n heelgetal-veelvoud van e wees

sections.title: Electric circuits

questions.q: Define electric current.
questions.qAf: Definieer elektriese stroom.
points: The rate of flow of charge
pointsAf: Die tempo van vloei van lading

questions.q: Calculate the equivalent resistance of R₂ and R₃.
questions.qAf: Bereken die ekwivalente weerstand van R₂ en R₃.

questions.q: Calculate the total resistance of the circuit.
questions.qAf: Bereken die totale weerstand van die stroombaan.

questions.q: Calculate the reading on the ammeter.
questions.qAf: Bereken die lesing op die ammeter.

questions.q: Calculate the reading on the voltmeter.
questions.qAf: Bereken die lesing op die voltmeter.

questions.q: Calculate the current through R₃.
questions.qAf: Bereken die stroom deur R₃.
points: V across the parallel part = 12 − 8 = 4 V
pointsAf: V oor die parallelle deel = 12 − 8 = 4 V

questions.q: Calculate the charge that passes through the battery in 2 minutes.
questions.qAf: Bereken die lading wat in 2 minute deur die battery vloei.

sections.intro: In the circuit below the battery has an emf of 12 V and negligible internal resistance. R₁ = 4 Ω is in series with R₂ = 6 Ω and R₃ = 3 Ω, which are in parallel. The ammeter and the connecting wires have negligible resistance, and the voltmeter has a very high resistance.
sections.introAf: In die stroombaan hieronder het die battery ’n emk van 12 V en weglaatbare interne weerstand. R₁ = 4 Ω is in serie met R₂ = 6 Ω en R₃ = 3 Ω, wat in parallel is. Die ammeter en die verbindingsdrade het weglaatbare weerstand, en die voltmeter het ’n baie hoë weerstand.
